notes.title: About big update for Jump1000
notes.notes:
There is a big update!
-I changed the UI and character design.
-I add a floor map that you can see where you are.
-I add in-game login to protect your game data.
-I changed 100 floor into 1000 floor.
-The balance of the game's jumping power has patched.
-There is a new story for the game.

notes.title: Game has been changed!
notes.notes:
Game has been changed into Jump1000, and I created a story for this game.
-Characters have been changed into rabbit.
-I add a floor map system on the left side.
-Jumping power stone design has been changed.
-Game balance has been changed.
